jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctoral researcher (12 months) Mathematics of energy-efficient AI: diffusion models on emerging hardware
jobs.description:
The question

Generating one image with a diffusion model means evaluating a large neural network tens to hundreds of times. That repetition is where the energy goes, and it is part of why data-centre demand is now visible at grid scale: the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory puts US data-centre electricity use at 176 TWh in 2023, 4.4 % of national consumption, a figure that more than doubled since 2017 largely because of AI servers, and projects 325–580 TWh by 2028. Emerging hardware attacks exactly this primitive: analog in-memory computing, silicon photonics, ferroelectric devices and stochastic computing perform the underlying matrix–vector products at lower energy than digital CMOS, under conditions on scale and precision, but return a perturbed result. The usual objection is that nobody can say in advance how much perturbation a model tolerates. In EMMA, this opportunity is pursued through a PCM-based photonic matrix–vector engine as the primary demonstrator, complemented where appropriate by FeFET-based analog computing, so that device-level non-idealities are treated as explicit design parameters rather than as after-the-fact implementation loss

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

Factories run on machines that generate huge amounts of data, and almost none of it gets used. We're changing that. Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden.

Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene.

Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard.

Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt.

Du arbeitest an echten offenen Fragen, zum Beispiel wie KI Kinderstimmen versteht und Fünfjährigen die Welt erklärt.

Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch.

Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden.

jobs.title: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting
jobs.description:
Prevention Analyst - Pentesting

About this role


We are looking for a Prevention Analyst - Pentester, to join our Prevention track. An attacker does not look at one server in isolation. They look at everything a company exposes to the internet and work out where to start. You will do the same for our clients, taking the attacker’s view of their external attack surface, seeing what an attacker sees, and doing what an attacker would do next.

That means reading the story behind an attack surface. A forgotten subdomain, an old login portal, and a misconfigured mail server may each look minor on their own. Together they can show how an organisation has grown, where its blind spots are, and where someone could get in. When you find a potential weak point, you dig into it technically to find out how far an attacker could actually go.

The Global Sellers Team mission at Back Market is to enable a stable supply of high quality refurbished products to our 17 markets. The team is fast-growing, we onboard and nurture great sellers to unlock the right products that our customers want.

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

 

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

About the Role
Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach.

We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting.

  • Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments.

jobs.title: Data analist Lenen, Sparen & Retailbeleggen
jobs.description:
De afdeling Lenen, Sparen en Retailbeleggen (LSR) houdt toezicht op financiële producten en diensten voor consumenten, zoals hypotheken, kredieten, sparen, betalen en beleggen. We zorgen dat informatie duidelijk is en dat online dienstverlening goed toegankelijk is. Samen zorgen we dat het klantbelang centraal staat, vooral voor kwetsbare groepen.

 

Ons toezicht richt zich op het herkennen en aanpakken van risico’s voor consumenten. We willen dit zo snel en effectief mogelijk doen. Om meer impact te maken, gebruiken we data op een slimme manier. Daarbij zoeken we continu naar signalen, toetsen we aannames en brengen we risico’s en mogelijke blinde vlekken in beeld. Zo kunnen we sneller inspelen op veranderingen in de financiële sector.

 

De vraagstukken waar je aan werkt zijn vaak nieuw, complex en actueel. Denk aan risico’s rond Buy Now Pay Later, online beleggingsplatformen, AI-toepassingen of ontwikkelingen in de cryptomarkt. Jouw analyses dragen direct bij aan keuzes die de AFM maakt in haar toezicht.
